title: Fox Corporation Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year Fiscal 2026 Financial Results
summary: NEW YORK, NY, August 6, 2026 – Fox Corporation (Nasdaq: FOXA, FOX; “FOX” or the “Company”) today reported financial results for the three months and twelve months ended June 30, 2026. Click here to view the full release.
body_markdown:
**NEW YORK, NY, August 6, 2026** – Fox Corporation (Nasdaq: FOXA, FOX; “FOX” or the “Company”) today reported financial results for the three months and twelve months ended June 30, 2026.


Click[here](https://media.foxcorporation.com/earnings/FY26/q4.pdf) to view the full release.
